tagline.en_US: Zotero is a free, easy-to-use tool to help you collect, organize, annotate, cite, and share research.

description.en_US: Zotero is a personal research assistant that helps collect, organize, annotate, cite, and share research materials. It manages bibliographic data and related research files, allowing users to keep references structured in a central library. It is widely used to track research sources and generate citations for academic and professional writing.
